Lightly oil an 8x8-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole. In a medium bowl, blend eggs, milk, vanilla and 1/4 cup sugar.
Pour over bread and fruit. Stir gently to wet all bread with egg mixture.
Just before baking, remove casserole from refrigerator. Uncover the casserole and sprinkle topping over fruit.

Bake until completely set and starting to brown, about 35 to 40 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees F on a food thermometer. A longer baking time is needed when the dish is chilled overnight.
